title: Context Fabric Thread v1
description: The caller's own Ask Dev conversation: GET /api/v1/context-fabric/threads/{thread_id}. A thread is the submission records one principal admitted with one X-ACR-Thread-ID, in admission order, plus its retention. It names each turn's result by id and carries no answer content; read a result with GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/{result_id}, which decides the read again. Another principal's thread, an unknown, deleted, expired or malformed id get the same 404 not_found.

retention_days.description: 0: kept until 24 hours after the last turn. 30: kept until 30 days after the last turn. Set by X-ACR-Thread-Retention-Days on a turn; the latest turn that named one decides, and a thread whose turns named none has 0.

turn_count.description: Every turn of the thread. Turns before the served page are read with the before query parameter and earlier_turns_cursor.

expires_at.description: last_turn_at plus 24 hours (retention_days 0) or 30 days (retention_days 30). From it on, the thread and the results of its turns are not served on any read, and the retention job removes them.

turns.description: One page of at most 100 turns, oldest first (admitted_at, then submission_id): the latest turns, or the turns before the cursor the before query parameter named.

earlier_turns_cursor.description: Present when turns earlier than this page exist: pass it back as the before query parameter. Opaque.

state.description: The submission's state, as GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/submissions/{submission_id} serves it. A done_unsaved answer was shown once and is not recoverable; ask again.

question.description: The question the turn was admitted with, as the caller sent it: the caller's own words, served so a reload can show a running, unsaved or abandoned turn too. Absent on a turn admitted before the service recorded questions.

result_id.description: On a done turn whose result GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/{result_id} would serve to the reader now (the stored-result gate admits the reader and the read's serving rules serve the result): the result's id.

result_withheld.description: On a done turn whose result GET /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/{result_id} would not serve to the reader now: the result is not served from this thread, and its id is not given.
